text.en: Owners consistently report major improvements in leash reactivity, command obedience, and social focus after completing training programs. Clients particularly praise the six-session course for shelter dogs, noting that reactive pets learned to remain calm around distractions. One reviewer questioned the training approach during an evaluation, but most found the progress remarkable.

Reviewers frequently praise trainer Cesar and the coaching team for their patience, clear guidance, and supportive teaching style. Dog handlers appreciate that instructors equip owners with practical techniques to manage stressful situations at home. Although one visitor felt staff were overly critical during a consultation, clients overwhelmingly appreciate the team's dedication.

title.en: Caring handling and shelter dog support

text.en: Many clients highlight the team's thoughtful care when working with rescued shelter dogs that enter training fearful or anxious. Reviewers appreciate that classes help strengthen the bond between handlers and pets through positive engagement. While one client voiced concern about stress signals during a demonstration dog drill, most owners feel their dogs were treated with respect.

q.en: Does ACA Center offer training for rescue dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently highlight the partnership with Miami-Dade Animal Services providing free foundation classes for adopted dogs.

q.en: Are the training sessions conducted in groups?

a.en: Yes, clients mention group sessions that help dogs practice staying focused on handlers around other animals.

q.en: How many sessions are included in the shelter program?

a.en: Clients mention completing a six-class training series that covers core obedience commands and leash manners.

q.en: Can the center help with dog reactivity?

a.en: Reviewers report noticeable progress in managing leash reactivity and barking around other dogs.
